ltm rule __tcl_lsp_2286_r2286m_backend {
    app-service none
    partition Common
when HTTP_REQUEST {
        HTTP::header insert X-R2286-Scope r2286m-backend
        log local0. "R2286BACKEND|r2286m|request=[HTTP::header value X-R2286-Request]|tmm=[TMM::cmp_group]:[TMM::cmp_unit]"
    }
    when HTTP_RESPONSE {
        HTTP::header insert X-R2286-TMM "[TMM::cmp_group]:[TMM::cmp_unit]"
    }
}
ltm rule __tcl_lsp_2286_r2286m_nul_counted_last {
    app-service none
    partition Common
when HTTP_REQUEST {
        set payload [binary format H* ]
        set rc [catch {eval $payload} result]
        binary scan $result H* result_hex
        log local0. "R2286 __tcl_lsp_2286_r2286m_nul_counted_last tmm=[TMM::cmp_group]:[TMM::cmp_unit] rc=$rc result_hex=$result_hex"
        HTTP::respond 200 content [list $rc $result_hex] X-R2286-TMM "[TMM::cmp_group]:[TMM::cmp_unit]" Connection close
    }
}

ltm rule /R2286_r2286m/lifetime/__tcl_lsp_2286_r2286m_caller {
    app-service none
    partition R2286_r2286m
when HTTP_REQUEST {
    set phase [HTTP::header value X-R2286-Phase]
    set request [HTTP::header value X-R2286-Request]
    set cell CALLER_SEED
    set target [HTTP::header value X-R2286-Target]
    if {[HTTP::path] eq "/two"} {
        set rc [catch {call $target cell EXPLICIT_SUFFIX} result]
        set actuals two
    } else {
        set rc [catch {call $target cell} result]
        set actuals one
    }
    binary scan $result H* result_hex
    binary scan $cell H* cell_hex
    log local0. "R2286LIFEHEADER|r2286m|phase=$phase|request=$request|actuals=$actuals|target=$target|tmm=[TMM::cmp_group]:[TMM::cmp_unit]|rc=$rc|result_hex=$result_hex|cell_hex=$cell_hex"
    HTTP::respond 200 content [list $rc $result_hex $cell_hex] X-R2286-TMM "[TMM::cmp_group]:[TMM::cmp_unit]" Connection close
}
}
ltm rule /R2286_r2286m/lifetime/__tcl_lsp_2286_r2286m_provider {
    app-service none
    partition R2286_r2286m
proc incarnation {name} {
    upvar 1 $name cell
    set cell OLD_WRITE
    set ns_command [binary format H* 6e616d6573706163652063757272656e74]
    set ns [eval $ns_command]
    return [list OLD $ns $cell]
}
}
